papers.title: Spatio-temporally complementary feature propagation on graphs for longitudinal AADT estimation
papers.title_zh: 面向纵向 AADT 估计的图时空互补特征传播
papers.reason: 该文提出时空互补特征传播框架用于城市网络多年 AADT 估计，直接涉及时空数据挖掘、多源数据融合与城市交通网络建模，与研究者方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: The estimation of Annual Average Daily Traffic (AADT) is vital for transportation planning and infrastructure maintenance, yet obtaining accurate values for an entire urban network across multiple years remains challenging due to the high cost and spatial sparsity of physical sensors. This research proposes a novel spatio-temporally complementary feature propagation framework that leverages the strengths of two distinct data sources: spatially sparse but temporally dense loop detector data, and a spatially complete but temporally sparse macroscopic transportation model. The methodology highlights a feature propagation algorithm on directed graphs, formulated as a Poisson energy minimization considering residues. The standard binary adjacency matrix is replaced with flow ratio matrices to capture real-world vehicle turn ratios at intersections. Validated in the city of Zurich, the algorithm demonstrates high computational efficiency, achieving convergence within minutes. Results indicate that the framework effectively reconciles theoretical models with empirical ground truths, yielding a normalized mean absolute error below $10\%$. This scalable approach provides a feasible solution for spatio-temporal network-wide AADT estimation through combining real-world limited sensor coverage and traffic models.
papers.summary_zh: 年平均日交通量（AADT）估计对交通规划与基础设施维护至关重要，但由于物理传感器成本高且空间稀疏，获取整个城市网络多年份的准确值仍具挑战。作者提出一种新颖的时空互补特征传播框架，利用两类数据源的优势：空间稀疏但时间密集的环形线圈检测器数据，以及空间完整但时间稀疏的宏观交通模型。方法核心是面向有向图的特征传播算法，形式化为考虑残差的泊松能量最小化。标准二值邻接矩阵被替换为流量比矩阵，以刻画交叉口真实车辆转向比例。在苏黎世市的验证表明，该算法计算效率高，可在数分钟内收敛。结果表明该框架有效调和理论模型与经验真值，归一化平均绝对误差低于 10%。该可扩展方法通过结合真实世界有限传感器覆盖与交通模型，为时空网络级 AADT 估计提供了可行方案。
papers.insight_zh: 其以流量比矩阵替代二值邻接、并以泊松能量最小化进行图特征传播的思路，可推广至其他传感器稀疏的城市时空场估计任务（如空气质量、人口流动），但需注意其验证仅限苏黎世单一城市。

papers.title: Evaluating Cross-region Generalization for Wavelet-Diffusion Precipitation Downscaling
papers.title_zh: 评估小波扩散降水降尺度的跨区域泛化能力
papers.reason: 该文评估小波扩散模型在降水降尺度中的跨区域与跨事件泛化，直接涉及遥感数据、空间统计(Moran's I)与地理空间智能，与遥感变化检测及多源数据融合研究高度相关。
papers.abstract: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for kilometer-scale precipitation downscaling, but their performance in geographically unseen regions and event regimes remains insufficiently understood. Building on the wavelet diffusion model (WDM) framework, this study evaluates cross-region and cross-event generalization. Six 3 x 3 deg U.S. regions represent convective, winter, tropical, and atmospheric-river precipitation regimes. Low-resolution inputs are generated by block averaging NOAA Multi-Radar/Multi-Sensor (MRMS) composite reflectivity fields. A WDM trained only on Oklahoma (OK) samples and a WDM trained on all six regions are compared with nearest-neighbor and Bicubic interpolation. Model performance is evaluated using three metric families that measure image-domain reconstruction, spectral and distributional fidelity, and bin-wise precipitation detection. The OK-trained WDM remains competitive outside OK. Although the all-region WDM delivers the best and most consistent overall image-domain and detection performance, its gains are uneven across precipitation intensities. Bin-wise critical success index (CSI) over 5-dBZ reflectivity bins shows that WDM improvements concentrate in localized higher-reflectivity structures, which image-domain metrics partly obscure. In addition, the performance differences among samples are strongly associated with the spatial organization of the precipitation field, quantified by Moran's I as the spatial autocorrelation of each reflectivity bin. The sample-level Moran's I-CSI correlation stratified by sample intensity reaches 0.901 in all six regions, including regions unseen during training. Overall, these findings support future efforts to transfer downscaling models to regions with limited local training data and to generate globally consistent, high-resolution precipitation products.
papers.summary_zh: 扩散模型在公里级降水降尺度上展现出强大潜力，但其在地理上未见区域及事件类型中的表现仍缺乏充分理解。基于小波扩散模型(WDM)框架，本研究评估跨区域与跨事件泛化。六个3×3度美国区域代表对流、冬季、热带与大气河降水类型。低分辨率输入由NOAA多雷达/多传感器(MRMS)复合反射率场经块平均生成。作者比较了仅在俄克拉荷马(OK)训练的WDM、在全部六个区域训练的WDM，以及最近邻与双三次插值。模型性能通过三类指标评估：图像域重建、频谱与分布保真度、以及分箱降水检测。仅在OK训练的WDM在OK之外仍具竞争力。尽管全区域WDM在整体图像域与检测性能上最佳且最一致，其增益在不同降水强度上并不均匀。超过5-dBZ反射率分箱的逐箱临界成功指数(CSI)显示，WDM改进集中在局部高反射率结构，而图像域指标部分掩盖了这一点。此外，样本间性能差异与降水场的空间组织密切相关，以各反射率分箱的空间自相关Moran's I量化。按样本强度分层的样本级Moran's I-CSI相关性在全部六个区域(包括训练中未见区域)达到0.901。总体而言，这些发现支持未来将降尺度模型迁移到本地训练数据有限的区域，并生成……
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示扩散降尺度模型的跨区域泛化与降水场空间组织(以Moran's I量化)强相关，逐箱检测指标能揭示图像域指标掩盖的改进；对遥感变化检测与多源数据融合中的空间统计评估有直接借鉴意义。

papers.title: GeoRefer-Bench: A Benchmark from Referring Pixels to Verifiable Geospatial Reasoning
papers.title_zh: GeoRefer-Bench：从指代像素到可验证地理空间推理的基准
papers.reason: 该文构建了面向地理空间指代分割的可验证推理基准，涉及航拍影像、空间关系推理与可执行查询评估，与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合和地理空间智能高度相关，对GIS研究具有直接参考价值。
papers.abstract: Referring segmentation in overhead imagery is inherently relational: a query may ask for the buildings north of the road or the pond closest to a residential area, so the correct referent can contain one object, several objects, or none. Existing benchmarks mainly score mask overlap, which cannot verify whether a model actually resolved the stated spatial relation. We introduce GeoRefer-Bench, a benchmark for verifiable geospatial referring segmentation. Each query is represented by an executable logical form over a metric scene graph, and predictions are evaluated with Exact Query Success (EQS), which is satisfied only when the returned instance set exactly matches the set denoted by the query. GeoRefer-Bench contains 700 whole 2048x2048 UAV scenes (2.94 Gpx) at 12.5 and 25 cm ground sampling distance, 26,217 instances, 142,796 spatial relations, and 20,916 executable queries spanning five reasoning levels. It further includes three paraphrases per query, 24.0% unanswerable queries, 2,477 counterfactual pairs, and five leakage-controlled evaluation splits. An independent audit re-derives object geometry, mask ownership, relation values, query execution, and split provenance, finding zero issues across all 700 scenes. Relation-blind strategies can retain non-trivial mIoU while achieving at most 22.7 EQS overall, showing that overlap alone does not certify relational grounding. Across fifteen current models, the strongest reaches 74.1 EQS but drops from 98.9 at level 1 to 60.5 at level 5, while ten models score below 5 EQS on two-hop queries. GeoRefer-Bench turns geospatial referring segmentation from mask matching into verifiable reference resolution.
papers.summary_zh: 航拍影像中的指代分割本质上是关系性的：查询可能要求找出道路以北的建筑物或距离住宅区最近的池塘，因此正确的指代对象可能包含一个、多个或零个目标。现有基准主要评估掩码重叠度，无法验证模型是否真正解析了所述空间关系。作者提出GeoRefer-Bench，一个用于可验证地理空间指代分割的基准。每个查询表示为度量场景图上的可执行逻辑形式，预测结果采用精确查询成功（EQS）评估，仅当返回的实例集合与查询所指集合完全匹配时才满足。GeoRefer-Bench包含700个完整的2048x2048无人机场景（2.94 Gpx），地面采样距离为12.5和25厘米，26,217个实例，142,796个空间关系，以及跨越五个推理层级的20,916个可执行查询。它还包含每个查询的三个复述、24.0%的不可回答查询、2,477个反事实对，以及五个泄漏控制的评估划分。独立审计重新推导了目标几何、掩码归属、关系值、查询执行和划分来源，在全部700个场景中未发现问题。关系盲策略可保持非平凡的mIoU，但整体EQS最高仅为22.7，表明仅靠重叠无法证明关系接地。在十五个当前模型中，最强模型达到74.1 EQS，但从第1级的98.9下降到第5级的60.5，且有十个模型在两跳查询上EQS低于5。GeoRefer-Bench将地理空间指代分割从掩码匹配转变为可验证的指代解析。
papers.insight_zh: 该基准强调空间关系的可验证解析而非单纯掩码重叠，其度量场景图与可执行逻辑形式的设计思路，可为城市更新中的空间关系查询、遥感变化检测中的关系推理评估提供方法论借鉴。

papers.title: GeoNLI - A Natural Language Interpreter for Satellite Imagery
papers.title_zh: GeoNLI——面向卫星影像的自然语言解释器
papers.reason: 该文构建面向卫星影像的自然语言解释统一管线，涉及遥感图像描述、视觉问答与视觉定位，与研究者关注的遥感与地理空间智能方向直接相关。
papers.abstract: Multi-modal multitasking models have shown strong performance on remote sensing datasets. However, because these models are trained on heterogeneous data and vary across tasks, designing a unified model that performs well in captioning, visual question answering (VQA), and visual grounding remains challenging. In this work, we evaluate several models on the VRS Bench and NWPU-VHR-10 datasets. The EarthMind model demonstrates strong results in both captioning and VQA. For grounding, we propose multiple pipelines - RemoteSAM-SAM-v1, RemoteSAM-SAM-v2, and DiffuSAM - and ultimately adopt a majority-voting ensemble across EarthMind, RemoteSAM, SAM3, Falcon, RemoteSAM-SAM3-v1, RemoteSAM-SAM3-v2, and DiffuSAM predictions. Our unified, modular pipeline integrates advanced SAM variants with multimodal LLMs to jointly perform captioning, VQA, and grounding. It achieves 82% accuracy on captioning and 83.32% on VQA, with 90.94%, 52.04%, and 92.06% for binary, numeric, and semantic question types respectively. For grounding, it attains 64.94% accuracy. By combining diverse VLMs with our custom RemoteSAM-SAM3 models through ensemble majority voting, the system delivers more accurate and consistent remote-sensing understanding than task-specific approaches.
papers.summary_zh: 多模态多任务模型在遥感数据集上表现强劲，但由于训练数据异质且任务各异，设计一个在图像描述、视觉问答（VQA）与视觉定位上均表现良好的统一模型仍具挑战。作者在 VRS Bench 与 NWPU-VHR-10 数据集上评估了多个模型，EarthMind 在图像描述与 VQA 上表现突出。针对视觉定位，作者提出多条管线——RemoteSAM-SAM-v1、RemoteSAM-SAM-v2 与 DiffuSAM——并最终采用 EarthMind、RemoteSAM、SAM3、Falcon、RemoteSAM-SAM3-v1、RemoteSAM-SAM3-v2 与 DiffuSAM 预测的多数投票集成。其统一模块化管线将先进 SAM 变体与多模态 LLM 结合，联合执行图像描述、VQA 与视觉定位，在图像描述上达到 82% 准确率，VQA 达 83.32%，其中二值、数值与语义问题类型分别为 90.94%、52.04% 与 92.06%；视觉定位准确率为 64.94%。通过将多样 VLM 与自研 RemoteSAM-SAM3 模型以集成多数投票结合，该系统相比任务专用方法提供更准确、更一致的遥感理解。
papers.insight_zh: 其模块化集成与多数投票策略为遥感多任务统一建模提供了工程参考，但数值型 VQA 准确率明显偏低，提示定量空间推理仍是薄弱环节；该文未涉及变化检测或时序分析。

papers.title: Calibration is the Bottleneck: An Action-Class Diagnostic of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling
papers.title_zh: 校准是瓶颈：多轮工具调用的动作类诊断
papers.reason: 提出多轮工具调用评估的诊断框架，区分动作类失准与执行失败，对理解和改进LLM智能体行为至关重要，与LLM和多智能体研究方向高度契合。
papers.abstract: Multi-turn tool calling is a core evaluation scenario for large language model (LLM) agents. On public tool-calling benchmarks, open-weight models now approach or even surpass closed-source frontier models in aggregate accuracy. However, this metric averages over many different multi-turn situations and obscures whether progress is balanced across them. We propose an action-class-oriented diagnostic framework that decomposes multi-turn failures into two orthogonal modes: action-class miscalibration and action-execution failure. The framework operates over a four-class action space (TOOL_CALL/ASK/REFUSE/CONFIRM) and introduces a self-revealing upper bound Acc <= GAR (Gold Action Recall); the two modes show up as bound violation (Acc > GAR, exposing state-grader masking of miscalibration) and large bound slack (GAR >> Acc, localizing execution failure within TOOL_CALL). We validate it on a panel of tool-calling models across multiple multi-turn benchmarks. Across our panel, the diagnostic reveals action-class miscalibration as a substantial failure mode the state grader cannot see. This gap inflates standing for heavily tool-trained families, which our diagnostic separates from families with context-appropriate action choice. Calibration is reshapable through context-only perturbations, but the reshape is heterogeneous: a single perturbation moves accuracy in opposite directions across families (up to +11.5 vs -21.0 pp on the same scenario), and its effect further depends on the perturbation mechanism. We argue that multi-turn tool-calling evaluations should supplement aggregate accuracy with action-class diagnostics that expose what the model actually does in each scenario.
papers.summary_zh: 提出一个动作类诊断框架，将多轮工具调用失败分解为动作类失准和执行失败，并引入自揭示上界Acc <= GAR来识别状态评分器无法察觉的失准问题。
papers.insight_zh: 多轮工具调用的总体准确率可能掩盖动作类失准问题，需结合动作类诊断以揭示模型在具体场景中的真实行为，且校准扰动对不同模型影响方向可能相反。

papers.title: VLANeXt: Recipes for Building Strong VLA Models
papers.title_zh: VLANeXt：构建强VLA模型的配方
papers.reason: 该研究探讨构建强视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的方法，与GIS中视觉-语言模型在地理场景理解中的应用相关，但侧重机器人动作。
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出了VLANeXt，一套构建强视觉-语言-动作模型的系统方法，包括数据、架构和训练策略的优化，旨在提升模型在具身智能任务中的表现。
papers.insight_zh: VLA模型的构建经验可迁移至地理空间视觉-语言任务，但需注意动作空间与地理决策的差异。

papers.title: FoCal: Frequency-Oriented Cross-Modal Interaction and Spectral Calibration for Aerial Visible-Infrared Object Detection
papers.title_zh: FoCal：面向航空可见光-红外目标检测的频率导向跨模态交互与光谱校准
papers.reason: 该论文研究航空RGB-IR多模态目标检测中的跨模态频域交互与光谱校准，与用户的多源数据融合和遥感方向高度相关，但更偏向目标检测而非变化检测。
papers.abstract: In aerial RGB--IR object detection, effectively exploiting complementary information across modalities is critical for robust perception under complex illumination and environmental conditions. Existing multimodal detectors mainly focus on spatial-domain interaction or frequency-specific feature enhancement, while the cross-modal interaction patterns of different frequency components remain insufficiently explored. Moreover, spectral discrepancy itself may contain both useful complementary cues and unreliable modality-specific responses, making indiscriminate frequency fusion suboptimal. To address these issues, we propose FoCal, a frequency-oriented framework for aerial RGB--IR object detection. First, a Frequency-Aware Dual-Domain Calibration (FADC) module is developed to explicitly model frequency-dependent cross-modal interaction. Low-frequency components are collaboratively consolidated into a shared structural consensus, whereas high-frequency components preserve modality-specific information through selective cross-modal exchange. The resulting frequency-aware cues are further transferred to the original feature domain to regulate cross-modal calibration. Second, we introduce a Discrepancy-Guided Spectral Modulation (DGSM) module, which characterizes cross-modal spectral imbalance using confidence-weighted relative amplitude discrepancy and transforms it into a bounded signed gate for adaptive enhancement, preservation, or attenuation of the joint multimodal spectrum. Extensive experiments on DroneVehicle, ESCVehicle, and ATR-UMOD demonstrate the effectiveness of FoCal, yielding $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ values of 83.5\%, 54.8\%, and 64.6\%, respectively. Meanwhile, with only 3.0M parameters, FoCal achieves 113.6 FPS while preserving leading detection accuracy, highlighting a favorable accuracy--efficiency trade-off. Code is available at {https://github.com/universeliang/FoCal.
papers.summary_zh: 针对航空RGB-IR目标检测中跨模态互补信息利用不足的问题，本文提出FoCal框架。首先设计频率感知双域校准（FADC）模块，显式建模频率相关的跨模态交互：低频分量协同整合为共享结构共识，高频分量通过选择性跨模态交换保留模态特有信息，并将频率感知线索迁移回原始特征域以调控跨模态校准。其次引入差异引导光谱调制（DGSM）模块，利用置信度加权的相对幅度差异刻画跨模态光谱失衡，并将其转化为有界符号门控，实现对联合多模态频谱的自适应增强、保留或衰减。在DroneVehicle、ESCVehicle和ATR-UMOD数据集上的实验表明，FoCal分别取得83.5%、54.8%和64.6%的mAP50，仅3.0M参数下达到113.6 FPS，同时保持领先检测精度。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示在多源遥感融合中，频域分解与跨模态差异建模可作为提升复杂光照条件下鲁棒感知的有效手段，其轻量化设计思路对边缘部署场景具有参考价值。

papers.title: DecoVAE: a Lightweight Interpretable Trend-Seasonal VAE Framework for Efficient Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.title_zh: DecoVAE：一种用于高效概率时间序列预测的轻量级可解释趋势-季节VAE框架
papers.reason: 该文提出一种轻量级、可解释的概率时间序列预测框架，与时空数据挖掘中的城市动态预测高度相关，其趋势-季节分解思想可直接应用于城市更新中的指标预测。
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出DecoVAE，一个轻量级、可解释的趋势-季节变分自编码器框架。它通过领域特定的归纳偏置将时间序列显式分解为趋势和季节成分：趋势流使用微分正则化器强制潜在轨迹平滑，季节流通过复数高斯VAE在频域操作以捕捉周期模式的振幅和相位。在多个基准上，DecoVAE在预测精度上超越强基线，同时大幅减少模型权重并提升速度。
papers.insight_zh: 将时间序列显式分解为趋势和季节成分并分别建模，不仅能提升预测精度和效率，还增强了模型的可解释性，这对于理解城市更新中复杂指标的演变规律和驱动因素具有重要意义。

papers.title: Capturing Unseen Spatial Heat Extremes Through Dependence-Aware Generative Modeling
papers.title_zh: 通过依赖感知生成建模捕捉未观测的空间极端高温
papers.reason: 该论文关注空间极端高温的依赖感知生成建模，直接涉及空间依赖建模与极端事件生成，与时空数据挖掘、地理空间智能及遥感应用高度相关，对城市更新中的气候风险分析亦有潜在价值。
papers.summary_zh: 摘要内容缺失，仅从标题可知该工作提出一种依赖感知的生成建模方法，用于捕捉未观测到的空间极端高温事件，强调对空间依赖结构的建模以生成或推断极端情形。
papers.insight_zh: 摘要缺失，无法确认其模型结构、数据来源与验证结果；从标题推断其空间依赖建模思路或可迁移至城市热环境与气候变化相关的时空分析，但这一推断缺乏摘要支撑。

papers.title: CLaST: Context-aware Contrastive VAE for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.title_zh: CLaST：用于概率时间序列预测的上下文感知对比VAE
papers.reason: 该论文提出用于概率多变量时间序列预测的VAE框架，与GIS中时空数据挖掘、城市动态预测等方向高度相关，方法可迁移至城市更新中的时间序列分析。
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出CLaST，一种用于概率多变量时间序列预测的VAE框架。与现有生成模型不同，CLaST通过对比损失函数学习保留观测值之间上下文相似性的嵌入。在九个基准数据集上的实验表明，CLaST持续超越强基线方法，在短期预测中CRPS和NMAE分别提升高达16.4%和14.4%，在长期预测中分别提升高达48.6%和25.1%。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究强调通过对比学习增强潜在表示的表达能力，可有效捕捉时间序列中的内部时间依赖，为城市动态预测等GIS应用提供了新的建模思路。

papers.title: From Policy Documents to Structured Survey Responses: Evaluating Large Language Models for Policy Monitoring
papers.title_zh: 从政策文档到结构化调查响应：评估大语言模型用于政策监测
papers.reason: 该文评估LLM从政策文档生成结构化调查响应，属于LLM在政策信息抽取中的应用。与LLM和多智能体研究以及城市更新政策分析有较强关联，但未涉及地理空间数据或遥感，相关性中等偏高。
papers.abstract: Science, technology, and innovation policies are crucial for competitiveness, yet their diversity and scale make them difficult to map and monitor consistently. Existing approaches rely heavily on manual survey efforts, which are costly and challenging to scale across countries. Large language models (LLMs) enable new possibilities for extracting and structuring information from long and unstructured policy documents. This paper presents an application of LLMs as "AI respondents" for generating structured survey responses from policy texts. We develop a data extraction pipeline based on long-context in-context learning to map information from public web sources into predefined survey categories, including policy instruments, target groups, and thematic areas. The pipeline integrates a validation step using a secondary LLM to assess relevance and evidence, alongside comparisons with human-provided responses. Using a multi-country dataset, we evaluate the alignment between LLM-generated and human-generated outputs through overlap measures and cross-validation. Results show that LLMs achieve high agreement for structured indicators (84-95%), while differences remain in free-text fields, where models tend to provide more detailed procedural descriptions. These findings highlight the potential of hybrid human-AI workflows for policy monitoring, improving both efficiency and scalability while maintaining the need for human validation and contextual interpretation.
papers.summary_zh: 科学、技术和创新政策对竞争力至关重要，但其多样性和规模使其难以一致地映射和监测。现有方法严重依赖人工调查工作，成本高昂且难以跨国扩展。大语言模型为从长而结构化的政策文档中提取和结构化信息提供了新可能。本文提出将LLM作为“AI受访者”，从政策文本生成结构化调查响应。作者开发了一个基于长上下文上下文学习的数据抽取流水线，将公共网络来源的信息映射到预定义调查类别，包括政策工具、目标群体和主题领域。该流水线集成了一个使用次级LLM评估相关性和证据的验证步骤，并与人工提供的响应进行比较。使用多国数据集，作者通过重叠度量和交叉验证评估LLM生成输出与人工生成输出之间的一致性。结果表明，LLM在结构化指标上达到高一致性（84-95%），而在自由文本字段上仍存在差异，模型倾向于提供更详细的过程描述。这些发现凸显了混合人-AI工作流在政策监测中的潜力，在保持人工验证和情境解释需求的同时提高效率和可扩展性。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示，LLM可作为政策文本结构化抽取的辅助工具，其与人工响应在结构化指标上的一致性较高，这一思路或可应用于城市更新政策的多国比较或政策工具监测，但自由文本字段仍需人工验证。

papers.title: Frame-to-Panorama Localization and Context-Aware Sampling for Scene-Specific Ship Detection in a Smart Marina Testbed
papers.title_zh: 智慧码头试验台中面向场景特定船舶检测的帧到全景定位与上下文感知采样
papers.reason: 该论文研究智慧码头场景下的船舶检测，涉及PTZ视频的空间索引、全景定位和上下文感知采样，与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合和地理空间智能有较强关联。
papers.abstract: Smart maritime infrastructures provide continuous access to heterogeneous sensing streams, enabling repeated experimentation, digital-twin development, and AI-based maritime services. However, sensing hardware alone is not sufficient for scene-specific model development: historical video streams must also be spatially indexed, contextualized, and reduced to informative subsets for annotation. This paper presents a frame-to-panorama localization and context-aware sampling pipeline for ship detection in historical PTZ maritime video lacking reliable pan, tilt, and zoom metadata. The main contribution is an end-to-end data-curation approach that recovers camera-view information from historical PTZ video and combines it with environmental context and visual diversity to construct compact, scene-specific training sets. Specifically, frames are localized on a reference panorama using SuperPoint and LightGlue, enriched with weather and solar-state metadata, and selected through diversity sampling to preserve variation across camera view and environmental conditions. A second context-aware stage targets under-represented distant-vessel cases near the horizon using tile-level visual embeddings and Gaussian Mixture Model clustering. Applied within the CMMI MDigi-I Smart Marina testbed, the proposed pipeline reduces 40,718 candidate frames to 220 images for annotation, corresponding to a 99.5% reduction. A YOLO26-m detector fine-tuned on this subset achieves a mean AP50 of 94.78% $\pm$ 0.51% and a mean AP50-95 of 75.10% $\pm$ 1.73% under sequence-grouped five-fold cross-validation. These results demonstrate that highly redundant infrastructure video streams can be transformed into compact, spatially and contextually diverse training sets for scene-specific detector adaptation while substantially reducing annotation effort.
papers.summary_zh: 智慧海事基础设施提供对异构传感流的持续访问，支持重复实验、数字孪生开发和基于AI的海事服务。然而，仅有传感硬件不足以进行场景特定模型开发：历史视频流还必须进行空间索引、上下文化，并缩减为信息子集以供标注。本文提出一个帧到全景定位与上下文感知采样流水线，用于缺乏可靠云台变焦元数据的历史PTZ海事视频中的船舶检测。主要贡献是一个端到端数据策展方法，从历史PTZ视频中恢复相机视角信息，并结合环境上下文和视觉多样性构建紧凑的场景特定训练集。具体而言，使用SuperPoint和LightGlue将帧定位到参考全景图上，用天气和太阳状态元数据丰富，并通过多样性采样选择以保持相机视角和环境条件的变化。第二个上下文感知阶段针对地平线附近代表性不足的远距离船只情况，使用块级视觉嵌入和高斯混合模型聚类。在CMMI MDigi-I智慧码头试验台中应用，所提流水线将40,718个候选帧缩减为220张图像用于标注，对应99.5%的缩减。在此子集上微调的YOLO26-m检测器在序列分组五折交叉验证下达到平均AP50为94.78% ± 0.51%和平均AP50-95为75.10% ± 1.73%。这些结果表明，高度冗余的基础设施视频流可以转化为紧凑、空间和上下文多样的训练集，用于场景特定检测器自适应。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作展示了如何将冗余的PTZ视频流通过空间定位与上下文感知采样转化为高效训练集，其数据策展思路对城市遥感视频监控中的变化检测与目标识别具有直接借鉴意义，尤其是远距离小目标采样策略。

papers.title: IterSynth: Rethinking Deep Search Agents via Role-Decoupled Iterative Synthesis
papers.title_zh: IterSynth：通过角色解耦迭代合成重新思考深度搜索智能体
papers.reason: 该论文提出基于LLM的深度搜索智能体框架，涉及多智能体角色解耦与强化学习，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市应用。
papers.abstract: Deep search requires LLM agents to decompose complex queries, search for evidence, and synthesize grounded answers, yet existing ReAct-style agents suffer from two limitations: role coupling, where one policy must handle planning, evidence use, and synthesis; and context accumulation, where growing search histories introduce noise and obscure useful information. To address these issues, we propose IterSynth, a role-decoupled and summary-based paradigm that alternates between a Planner for identifying information needs and a Synthesizer for integrating evidence into an evolving summary state. This design separates planning from synthesis while using the summary as the persistent state of search, reducing both capability coupling and context noise. To train IterSynth effectively, we further introduce Role-Decoupled Policy Optimization (RDPO) for reinforcement learning, which combines terminal outcome rewards with turn-level rubric evaluations and computes role-specific advantages for more precise credit assignment. Experiments on five long-horizon deep-search benchmarks such as BrowseComp and Xbench-DS show that IterSynth-8B achieves an average score of 50.7, surpassing the strongest prior $\leq$8B agent by +4.2\%. Moreover, IterSynth serves as a model-agnostic prompting paradigm, delivering substantial zero-shot gains over ReAct and similar prompting paradigms on frontier proprietary models.
papers.summary_zh: 深度搜索要求LLM智能体分解复杂查询、搜索证据并合成有依据的答案，但现有ReAct风格智能体存在两个局限：角色耦合，即一个策略必须同时处理规划、证据使用和合成；以及上下文累积，即不断增长的搜索历史引入噪声并掩盖有用信息。为解决这些问题，我们提出IterSynth，一种角色解耦且基于摘要的范式，在负责识别信息需求的规划器和负责将证据整合为演进摘要状态的合成器之间交替。该设计将规划与合成分离，同时使用摘要作为搜索的持久状态，减少能力耦合和上下文噪声。为有效训练IterSynth，我们进一步引入角色解耦策略优化（RDPO）用于强化学习，它结合终端结果奖励与轮级评分评估，并计算角色特定优势以实现更精确的信用分配。在BrowseComp和Xbench-DS等五个长时域深度搜索基准上的实验表明，IterSynth-8B平均得分50.7，超过最强的先前≤8B智能体4.2%。此外，IterSynth作为一种模型无关的提示范式，在前沿专有模型上相较ReAct及类似提示范式带来显著的零样本增益。
papers.insight_zh: 角色解耦与摘要状态机制可能可迁移至地理空间智能体中的多步空间查询与证据整合任务，但论文未验证地理空间场景，需进一步适配。

papers.title: Lightweight Probabilistic Downscaling from a Deterministic Base Model
papers.title_zh: 基于确定性基础模型的轻量级概率降尺度
papers.reason: 该文研究气候数据降尺度，属于遥感与地理空间数据空间分辨率提升的方法研究。与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合有方法层面的关联，但未涉及城市更新或时空数据挖掘，相关性中等偏高。
papers.abstract: Climate data downscaling is the task of increasing the spatial resolution of climate data, typically by generating fine-resolution regional climate data from coarse global model output. Recent machine learning (ML) work in the related task of weather forecasting has seen significant improvements due to newly devised training methods and architectural components, but these have not yet benefited downscaling. We adapt two of these methods to create a family of lightweight probabilistic ML downscaling models built on a modified U-Net backbone and evaluate them on the CORDEX-ML-Bench suite for daily maximum temperature and precipitation across three geographic regions: the Alps, New Zealand and South Africa. We find that a two-stage training curriculum, combining deterministic pretraining with probabilistic tuning, transfers well to downscaling, beating the state-of-the-art for RMSE. Our work provides an advancement towards lightweight, probabilistic downscaling models, reducing the current trade-off between computational intensity and distributional fit.
papers.summary_zh: 气候数据降尺度是指提高气候数据空间分辨率的任务，通常是从粗分辨率全球模式输出生成细分辨率区域气候数据。近期机器学习在相关天气预报任务中因新训练方法和架构组件而取得显著进展，但这些尚未惠及降尺度。本文将其中两种方法加以适配，构建了一族基于改进U-Net骨干的轻量级概率ML降尺度模型，并在CORDEX-ML-Bench套件上针对阿尔卑斯、新西兰和南非三个地理区域的日最高温度和降水进行评估。作者发现，将确定性预训练与概率微调相结合的两阶段训练课程能够很好地迁移到降尺度任务，在RMSE上优于当前最先进方法。该工作朝着轻量级概率降尺度模型迈进，缓解了当前计算强度与分布拟合之间的权衡。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示，将确定性预训练与概率微调结合的两阶段策略可能有助于在计算资源受限条件下实现概率降尺度，这一思路或可迁移到遥感影像空间分辨率提升或多源地理数据融合中，但其验证限于气候变量和特定区域。

papers.title: Evaluation of Multi-Turn Consistency in LLM Agents: Survival Analysis and Failure-Rationale Taxonomy
papers.title_zh: LLM 智能体多轮一致性评估：生存分析与失败归因分类法
papers.reason: 该文评估 LLM 智能体在多轮交互中的时间一致性与失败模式，与研究者关注的 LLM 与多智能体方向高度契合，其生存分析与失败归因分类法可为智能体可靠性评估提供方法参考。
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents may perform well on isolated tasks yet drift into inconsistency over extended interaction. We evaluate temporal consistency in a controlled 20-step multi-agent setting inspired by delayed-gratification studies. At each step, an agent chooses between continuing to delay a reward or claiming it immediately (terminating the episode). Across a full-factorial manipulation of social visibility (private vs public), persona stressors, and deliberation policy, we run 84,540 trajectories spanning 8 model families. Treating the first reward-claim as a time-to-event outcome, we estimate Kaplan-Meier survival curves and fit discrete-time hazard regression to quantify how experimental factors shift failure risk over time. Then, to analyze rationales and language patterns associated with failure, we build a seven-category taxonomy from 13,780 deliberation traces from agents who choose to terminate the episode, using an LLM-assisted labeling paired with human audit ($\kappa=0.83$). Rationale profiles change systematically with time and context: early failures are more impulse-driven, later failures more fatigue- and cost-benefit-framed, while public settings increase norm-oriented justifications. We also find a deliberation-inconsistency association: among failures, longer deliberation correlates with higher rates of intra-rationale contradiction (simultaneous pro-delay and pro-claim statements), challenging the assumption that more reasoning text implies greater consistency. Together, the survival and rationale analyses reveal distinct temporal reliability regimes and model-specific "failure fingerprints", offering an evaluation lens for diagnosing inconsistency in multi-turn agent behavior.
papers.summary_zh: LLM 智能体在孤立任务上表现良好，但在长时间交互中可能漂移为不一致。作者在受延迟满足研究启发的受控 20 步多智能体设定中评估时间一致性：每一步智能体需在继续延迟奖励与立即领取（终止回合）之间选择。在社交可见性（私密 vs 公开）、人格压力源与审议策略的全因子操控下，作者运行了覆盖 8 个模型家族的 84,540 条轨迹。将首次领取奖励视为时间到事件结果，估计 Kaplan-Meier 生存曲线并拟合离散时间风险回归，量化实验因素如何随时间改变失败风险。随后，为分析失败相关的理由与语言模式，作者基于 13,780 条选择终止回合的智能体审议轨迹构建七类分类法，采用 LLM 辅助标注并配合人工审核（κ=0.83）。理由画像随时间和情境系统性变化：早期失败更多由冲动驱动，后期失败更多以疲劳与成本收益框架表述，而公开情境增加规范导向的辩护。作者还发现审议-不一致关联：在失败案例中，更长的审议与更高的理由内部矛盾率（同时出现支持延迟与支持领取的陈述）相关，挑战了更多推理文本意味着更高一致性的假设。生存分析与理由分析共同揭示了不同的时间可靠性机制与模型特定的“失败指纹”。
papers.insight_zh: 其生存分析与失败归因分类法可迁移至地理空间智能体的长时任务可靠性评估（如多步空间规划与数据查询），但该文实验为抽象延迟满足场景，未涉及地理任务。

papers.title: A hybrid analytical-PINN model for subsurface simulation of geothermal heat exchangers in heterogeneous underground
papers.title_zh: 非均质地下地热换热器地下模拟的混合解析-PINN模型
papers.reason: 该论文提出混合解析-PINN模型用于非均质地下地热换热器模拟，与地理空间智能和物理模拟有交叉，但非城市更新或遥感核心方向。
papers.summary_zh: 摘要内容缺失（仅提供分隔线），无法获取具体方法、实验或结论信息。
papers.insight_zh: 物理信息神经网络在地下模拟中的应用或可启发城市地下空间与地热资源的时空建模，但需全文确认。

papers.title: Jev-Mobile: Jev as an Executor for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: Jev-Mobile：以Jev作为移动GUI智能体的执行器
papers.reason: 该文提出移动GUI智能体的规划-执行解耦架构，属于LLM/VLM智能体方向，与研究中LLM和多智能体部分相关，但不涉及地理空间或城市应用。
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for autonomous mobile GUI agents, but most existing systems rely on the VLM for both planning and action grounding at nearly every interaction step, leading to substantial latency and model-serving cost. We introduce Jev-Mobile, which shifts this paradigm to low-frequency VLM planning and high-frequency lightweight execution: the VLM specifies local goals, the accessibility tree defines a structured executable action space, and Jev, a fast typed decision model, repeatedly selects actions within this space. This design allows multiple GUI actions to be executed under a single VLM decision, reducing expensive VLM inference while preserving adaptive interaction. On the full AndroidWorld task suite, Jev-Mobile achieves 79% task success, compared with 78% for SeeAct-V and 84% for a Step-wise VLM baseline. Among successful trajectories, it reduces mean end-to-end execution time by 32.7% and mean model API cost by 73.4% relative to Step-wise VLM. These results show that decoupling high-level VLM reasoning from low-level action execution can substantially improve mobile GUI agent efficiency while maintaining competitive task performance.
papers.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）已成为自主移动GUI智能体的常见基础，但多数现有系统在几乎每个交互步骤都依赖VLM同时进行规划和动作落地，导致显著的延迟和模型服务成本。我们提出Jev-Mobile，将这一范式转变为低频VLM规划与高频轻量执行：VLM指定局部目标，可访问性树定义结构化可执行动作空间，Jev这一快速类型化决策模型在该空间内反复选择动作。该设计允许在单次VLM决策下执行多个GUI动作，减少昂贵的VLM推理同时保持自适应交互。在完整的AndroidWorld任务套件上，Jev-Mobile达到79%的任务成功率，而SeeAct-V为78%，逐步VLM基线为84%。在成功轨迹中，相对于逐步VLM，它将平均端到端执行时间减少32.7%，平均模型API成本减少73.4%。这些结果表明，将高层VLM推理与低层动作执行解耦可以在保持竞争性任务性能的同时显著提升移动GUI智能体效率。
papers.insight_zh: 该文提出的规划-执行解耦思路可降低智能体推理成本，对多智能体系统设计有参考价值；但其应用场景为移动GUI交互，与地理空间智能无直接关联。

papers.title: RD-JEPA: Predictive latent pretraining for few-trajectory transfer across reaction--diffusion equations
papers.title_zh: RD-JEPA：面向反应扩散方程少轨迹迁移的预测性潜空间预训练
papers.reason: 该文提出RD-JEPA，用于反应扩散方程轨迹的自监督预训练与少样本迁移，属于时空动力学代理建模。与时空数据挖掘和地理空间智能有方法层面的关联，但未涉及城市、遥感或地理空间数据，因此相关性中等。
papers.abstract: Learning surrogates for time-dependent partial differential equations often requires a new simulation corpus when the governing operator changes. We introduce RD-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive architecture for self-supervised pretraining on reaction-diffusion trajectories. A single model is pretrained on five parameterized systems and then adapted to three held-out systems whose reaction operators and trajectories are excluded from pretraining. Using one, five, or ten complete trajectories from a held-out system, RD-JEPA achieves lower mean relative discrete $\ell^2$ field error and mean absolute spatial first-difference error than five supervised surrogate baselines, an independently trained control that removes the trajectory-dependent predictive latent pathway, and an architecture-matched model trained from scratch. Within the evaluated equations, output resolution, forecast horizons, and choices of adaptation trajectories, the results indicate that prediction of future-state representations can support data-efficient adaptation across related reaction-diffusion systems.
papers.summary_zh: 针对含时偏微分方程的代理学习通常需要在控制算子变化时重新构建仿真语料的问题，本文提出RD-JEPA，一种用于反应扩散轨迹自监督预训练的联合嵌入预测架构。单一模型在五个参数化系统上预训练，随后适配到三个留出系统，这些系统的反应算子和轨迹均未参与预训练。使用留出系统的一条、五条或十条完整轨迹时，RD-JEPA在平均相对离散ℓ²场误差和平均绝对空间一阶差分误差上均优于五个监督代理基线、一个去除轨迹相关预测潜路径的独立训练对照，以及一个架构匹配的从零训练模型。在所评估的方程、输出分辨率、预测时域和适配轨迹选择范围内，结果表明对未来状态表征的预测能够支持相关反应扩散系统间的数据高效适配。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示，预测性潜空间预训练可能有助于在动力学算子发生变化时减少对大量仿真数据的依赖，这一思路或可迁移到城市时空场或遥感时序变化的代理建模中，但需注意其验证范围仅限于反应扩散方程。

papers.title: UpDown-SC: Gravity-Canonicalized Dual-Envelope Scan Context for Indoor LiDAR Place Recognition
papers.title_zh: UpDown-SC：重力规范化双包络扫描上下文用于室内LiDAR地点识别
papers.reason: 该论文提出室内LiDAR地点识别描述子，属于地理空间感知与定位方向，但与用户核心关注的城市更新、时空数据挖掘、LLM多智能体及遥感变化检测关联较弱。
papers.abstract: LiDAR place recognition is a key front end for loop closure and global relocalization, yet indoor retrieval remains difficult when attitude or sensor mounting height changes between mapping and query sessions. Scan Context stores the maximum height in each polar cell; indoors, broad ceilings can suppress the lower and mid-level geometry that distinguishes adjacent rooms and corridors. We present UpDown-SC, a training-free polar descriptor that first canonicalizes gravity and then represents two complementary surfaces: the upper envelope of lower/middle structures and the lower envelope of overhead structures. Their physical split is estimated once from a cell-balanced map height distribution and reused by every query. A mask-aware, non-uniform two-channel distance retains discriminative lower-level evidence while limiting sensitivity to its cross-session variation, without treating unobserved cells as zero-height measurements. Conventional Scan Context shortlisting and circular yaw alignment are retained, so retrieved hypotheses directly initialize geometric verification. Experiments across repeated indoor sessions, mounting-height changes, mixed outdoor-to-indoor trajectories, and an outdoor transfer sequence show more reliable first-choice retrieval on the indoor and mounting-height-varied sessions. A paired test finds a significant gain over Scan Context on the in-house sessions. UpDown-SC also gives the best or second-best F1max and AUPR under threshold-based acceptance while retaining a lightweight CPU front end. Continuous replay confirms that the retrieved hypotheses support metric prior-map localization. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/jiejie567/updown-sc.
papers.summary_zh: LiDAR地点识别是回环检测与全局重定位的关键前端，但室内检索在建模与查询会话间姿态或传感器安装高度变化时仍很困难。Scan Context在每个极坐标单元存储最大高度，室内宽大天花板会抑制区分相邻房间与走廊的中低层几何。本文提出UpDown-SC，一种免训练的极坐标描述子，先进行重力规范化，再表示两个互补表面：中低层结构的上包络与顶部结构的下包络。二者的物理分界由单元均衡的地图高度分布一次性估计，并被所有查询复用。掩码感知的非均匀双通道距离保留判别性低层证据，同时限制其对跨会话变化的敏感性，且不将未观测单元视为零高度测量。方法保留传统Scan Context候选筛选与环形偏航对齐，使检索假设可直接初始化几何验证。在重复室内会话、安装高度变化、室外到室内混合轨迹及室外迁移序列上的实验表明，该方法在室内及安装高度变化会话中具有更可靠的首选检索。配对检验显示在自建会话上相对Scan Context有显著提升。在基于阈值的接受条件下，UpDown-SC也取得最佳或次佳的F1max与AUPR，同时保持轻量CPU前端。连续回放验证检索假设支持度量先验地图定位。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作表明在室内LiDAR地点识别中，显式分离上下包络并处理未观测单元可提升跨会话鲁棒性，其免训练与轻量特性对大规模室内建图与重定位具有实用意义。

papers.title: Token Clustering and Semantic Sequence Mamba for Hyperspectral Image Classification
papers.title_zh: Token聚类与语义序列Mamba用于高光谱图像分类
papers.reason: 该论文研究高光谱图像分类，属于遥感领域，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合研究方向有一定关联，但其方法聚焦于分类而非变化检测，且不涉及城市更新或时空数据挖掘。
papers.abstract: Although hyperspectral images (HSIs) provide rich spectral-spatial information, accurate pixel-level classification remains challenging because of spectral-spatial heterogeneity and complex spatial structures. Existing vision state space models (Mamba) typically construct sequences according to predefined spatial neighborhoods, without explicitly accounting for semantic similarity or spatial non-stationarity. To address this limitation, we propose Token Clustering and Semantic Sequence Mamba (STMamba), which organizes sparse tokens into semantically coherent sequences for hyperspectral image classification with the following features. First, at the macro level, a hierarchical encoder decoder progressively selects semantic tokens with the Token Clustering Module (TCM) and restores dense features using a parameter-free Cross-scale Neighborhood Attention (CNA) Upsampler. Second, at the micro level, TCM first identifies representative cluster centers through density-aware clustering and estimates soft memberships based on feature similarity. A quadtree-based dynamic selection strategy then retains sparse and spatially distributed tokens from each semantic cluster, forming coherent semantic-token sequences while reducing redundant pixel-wise representations. Third, parallel Spatial and Spectral Semantic-wise Sequencing Mamba (SWSM) modules capture complementary long-range spatial and spectral dependencies within homogeneous semantic token sequences while suppressing irrelevant interactions across heterogeneous regions. Experimental results on three large-scale benchmark datasets demonstrate that STMamba outperforms the SOTA methods with respect to quantitative and qualitative results.
papers.summary_zh: 尽管高光谱图像（HSI）提供了丰富的光谱-空间信息，但由于光谱-空间异质性和复杂的空间结构，准确的像素级分类仍然具有挑战性。现有的视觉状态空间模型（Mamba）通常根据预定义的空间邻域构建序列，而没有明确考虑语义相似性或空间非平稳性。为解决这一局限，我们提出了Token聚类与语义序列Mamba（STMamba），它将稀疏token组织成语义连贯的序列用于高光谱图像分类，具有以下特征。首先，在宏观层面，分层编码器-解码器通过Token聚类模块（TCM）逐步选择语义token，并使用无参数的跨尺度邻域注意力（CNA）上采样器恢复密集特征。其次，在微观层面，TCM首先通过密度感知聚类识别代表性聚类中心，并基于特征相似性估计软隶属度。然后，基于四叉树的动态选择策略从每个语义聚类中保留稀疏且空间分布的token，形成连贯的语义token序列，同时减少冗余的像素级表示。第三，并行的空间和光谱语义序列Mamba（SWSM）模块在同质语义token序列内捕捉互补的长程空间和光谱依赖关系，同时抑制异质区域之间的无关交互。在三个大规模基准数据集上的实验结果表明，STMamba在定量和定性结果上均优于SOTA方法。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究将Mamba状态空间模型与语义token聚类结合用于高光谱图像分类，其处理光谱-空间异质性的思路对遥感图像分析有参考价值，但未涉及变化检测或多源数据融合。

papers.title: Progressive Skill Discovery as Access Control for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Structural Governance through Role-Scoped Capability Delivery
papers.title_zh: 渐进式技能发现作为工具使用型 LLM 智能体的访问控制：基于角色范围能力交付的结构化治理
papers.reason: 该文研究工具使用型 LLM 智能体的能力治理与访问控制，与研究者关注的 LLM 与多智能体方向直接相关，但其应用场景为企业工具集治理，未涉及地理空间任务。
papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents struggle to scale safely when exposed to vast enterprise toolsets. Providing an agent with access to every internal tool leads to oversized context windows, degraded tool selection, and severe governance vulnerabilities - as system policies defined purely in prompts remain probabilistic advice rather than hard constraints. Existing mitigations, such as multi-agent domain delegation, decentralize audit logs and fail to guarantee policy compliance across sessions. We introduce skilder, a framework that packages capabilities into roles: bundles of skills, tools, and instructions, together with the limits that bound them. An agent begins with a minimal role catalog, learns the roles a task requires, and receives each role's skills, instructions, and tools through a single MCP server. Because tools reach the agent only inside learned skills, the same server enforces the scope of what was learned deterministically. We evaluate skilder against flat-context tool selection and multi-agent orchestration across 13 tasks using six models (10 runs each). Our results show that, when models completed discovery and issued a governed call, the skilder simulated authorization layer enforced governance boundaries: no unauthorized tool call or parameter violation (e.g., a spending-limit breach) executed. Aggregate task pass rates also reflect whether each model followed the discovery protocol and satisfied response-quality checks; those misses are not authorization failures. Furthermore, by allowing agents to dynamically acquire cross-role capabilities mid-task, skilder preserves problem-solving flexibility while providing hard system-level enforcement.
papers.summary_zh: LLM 智能体在接入庞大企业工具集时难以安全扩展：开放全部内部工具会导致上下文窗口过大、工具选择退化以及治理漏洞，因为仅以提示词定义的系统策略只是概率性建议而非硬约束。现有缓解手段（如多智能体领域委派）会分散审计日志且无法保证跨会话的策略合规。作者提出 skilder 框架，将能力打包为角色——即技能、工具、指令及其边界的集合。智能体从最小角色目录开始，学习任务所需的角色，并通过单一 MCP 服务器获取每个角色的技能、指令与工具。由于工具仅在学习到的技能内部到达智能体，同一服务器可确定性地执行所学范围。作者在 13 项任务、6 个模型（各 10 次运行）上对比扁平上下文工具选择与多智能体编排。结果显示，当模型完成发现并发起受治理调用时，skilder 模拟授权层未执行任何未授权工具调用或参数违规（如超支）。总体任务通过率还反映模型是否遵循发现协议并满足响应质量检查，这些未通过并非授权失败。此外，允许智能体在任务中途动态获取跨角色能力，使 skilder 在提供硬性系统级执行的同时保持问题求解灵活性。
papers.insight_zh: 该框架的角色化能力封装与确定性授权机制，可为地理空间智能体系统（如多源数据查询与地图服务调用）提供权限与上下文管理的设计参考，但其评估未涉及地理空间工具链。
